additional_info.subject: RE: 0373474 - ID0373474-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312562229/35]- Outlet 2 not available CRM:00752000575
additional_info.body:
Dear Franck,
I hope all is well with you. I'm Sambath, and I'll be supporting you on this case from expert team. Please find below details of analysis.
Observation:
It is clear that the set of converters is failing to group during the converter grouping. The converters on DC2 and DC4 are actually building the voltage during the converter grouping phase. Somehow this voltage is not detected by the voltage transducer and is failing to perform converter grouping.
Suspected Root Cause:
There can be a contactor malfunction from SMC 12 side (QA9/10) or a bus bar failure (melted bus bar leading to non-continuity).
Action Need to Plan:
Please plan a site intervention to replace the contactors and wiring checking.
Please let me know when we can plan the intervention so that I can support you for the same.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
